general_tips: Review lap from outside car, focusing on lift points, brake points, brake pressure, turn-in points.
extend angle of attack into T16 as much as possible
be decisive with track limits, use runoff area
Pay attention to the left rear wheel in high-speed entry to low-speed apexes
Inside rear tire has a tendency to lock up in second gear at low RPM
Be careful with inside rear tire locking up
Roll off brake or introduce throttle to prevent rear tire lockup
Increase speed or introduce throttle to free up inside rear wheel
Lots of short shifting just to get it into fourth gear.
use as much of the inside curb as you'd like
first lap tricky with low pressures, be easy with curbing
stay far left for first S to carry speed into second S
fourth gear, fourth gear, lift, brake, use left of curb
Use all of the runoff curbing on the backstretch
